integrity: The proof uses Hilbert's published degree formula plus an exact integer optimization over three-part partitions. A standalone checker exhaustively replays all partitions through degree 500 as regression evidence. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Only ordinary projective degrees of three-dimensional coincident root loci are classified. Higher-dimensional partitions, dual degrees, polar degrees, singular-locus degrees, equations, and real-rank boundaries are outside scope.
title: Extremal degrees of three-dimensional coincident root loci
